route_reason: The image is an illustrated scene (wall, ground, ladder) that must carry exact values, the 10 m length and the 60° angle, so it needs the layered route rather than illustration or plain geometry.

spec.scene: brick wall and flat ground, viewed from the side
spec.wall: vertical brick wall on the right, with the top edge of the ladder touching it
spec.ground: flat horizontal ground line meeting the foot of the wall at a right angle
spec.ladder: straight ladder from the ground to the wall, drawn as a single straight line
spec.angle_marked: 60° at the foot of the ladder, between the ladder and the ground
spec.overlay: exact angle arc at the ground and exact 10 m length label, no grid needed

must_show: An illustrated brick wall standing vertically on flat ground, with a ladder leaning against the wall so its foot is on the ground and its top touches the wall. The ladder's length is labelled 10 m along the ladder. The 60° angle is marked at the foot of the ladder, between the ladder and the ground. The height up the wall is not labelled, and the wall shows no measurement marks that give the height.
